Classic Tabby builds

Every published build keeps its page here; nothing is removed. If the device's update loader waits for a build (its USB MIDI name reads ota-SMK37 + 16 hex digits), open the page whose loader tag matches and continue the install from there. Back up before installing a build that moves the storage (tabby-v04.0 and later over v03.x).

Use it only if an install leaves the SMK-37 in its update loader named ota-SMK370000000000000000 (all zeros) and a power cycle does not boot it. It resumes after you confirm SMK-37 Pro and never uses force flash. For a normal install use builds/tabby-v04.0/.
